def transform(grid):
    # Each 3x3 input tile represents one output cell; keep its non-background marker.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range((w + 2) // 3)] for _ in range((h + 2) // 3)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value not in (0, 5):
                out[r // 3][c // 3] = value
    return out
PY
